title: Building Knowledge Graphs for Theses: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2610.28648v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Academic theses are a valuable source of scientific knowledge, yet their semantic exploitation remains limited. While Scholarly Knowledge Graphs have significantly advanced the representation of scientific publications, knowledge graph construction for academic theses has received comparatively limited attention. This paper provides a systematic review of existing approaches and analyzes their potential application for the thesis domain. We analyzed 46 peer-reviewed studies published between 2021 and 2025, and organised existing approaches into a structured classification of techniques, models, and tools. The review reveals a methodological evolution from natural language processing techniques for entity and relation extraction to ontology engineering, Semantic Web technologies, and AI-driven enrichment through knowledge graph embeddings, Linked Open Data, and Large Language Models. translated_title: 学位论文知识图谱构建：综述研究
translated_abstract: 学术学位论文是科学知识的宝贵来源，但其语义层面的开发利用仍然有限。尽管学术知识图谱已在科学出版物的表示方面取得显著进展，但针对学术学位论文的知识图谱构建却受到相对较少的关注。本文对现有方法进行了系统性综述，并分析了它们在学位论文领域的潜在应用。我们分析了2021年至2025年间发表的46项同行评审研究，并将现有方法归纳为技术、模型和工具的结构化分类。该综述揭示了方法论的演进历程：从用于实体和关系抽取的自然语言处理技术，发展到本体工程、语义网技术，以及通过知识图谱嵌入、关联开放数据和大语言模型实现的AI驱动增强。这些发现为该领域的研究现状提供了整合性的视角。
tldr: 本文系统综述了2021至2025年间46项关于学位论文知识图谱构建的同行评审研究，提出了技术、模型与工具的结构化分类体系，并揭示了从自然语言处理抽取技术到大语言模型驱动增强的方法论演进。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically surveys 46 peer-reviewed studies (2021–2025) on knowledge graph construction for academic theses, presenting a structured classification of techniques, models, and tools, and revealing the methodological evolution from NLP-based entity and relation extraction to AI-driven enrichment with LLMs.
